description: A set of components that share implicit state through a parent (`Tabs`, `Tabs.Tab`, `Tabs.Panel`) and are composed freely by the caller.
A component that grows a prop for every customization. Compound components avoid it by giving markup back to the caller.
A custom hook that reads the context and throws a clear error when a part is used outside its parent.
Legacy way to inject props into direct children. Breaks with wrappers; prefer context.
